name: @automattic/akismet
description: Official JavaScript SDK for the Akismet spam protection API
author: Automattic

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check:package: npm run build && publint && attw --pack . --profile esm-only && npm run check:version && npm run check:internals && npm run check:edge-types
scripts.check:version: node -e "import('./dist/index.js').then(({ SDK_VERSION }) => { if (SDK_VERSION !== require('./package.json').version) throw new Error('dist reports version ' + SDK_VERSION); })"
scripts.check:internals: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); const leaks = fs.readdirSync('dist', { recursive: true }).filter((f) => f.endsWith('.d.ts') && f !== 'http-client.d.ts' && /\bHttpClient\b|\bRequestContext\b/.test(fs.readFileSync('dist/' + f, 'utf8'))); if (leaks.length > 0) throw new Error('public typings name HttpClient or RequestContext: ' + leaks.join(', '));"
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); const { version } = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')); const file = 'src/version.ts'; fs.writeFileSync(file, fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8').replace(/(SDK_VERSION = ').*(')/, '\$1' + version + '\$2'));"
